statement_summary: Annual risk analysis using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority; no acceptance of High response-delay risks without a plan
Sanctions
No BAA no ePHI (including phone, recording, and AI services)
Six-year retention of security documentation
Unique accounts in every system including CAD; no position or vehicle accounts
MFA for all sensitive access; hardware keys for admins
Same-day access removal at departure
Quarterly access reviews; billing edit rights reviewed
Break-glass accounts and sealed CAD admin credential
Unique device passwords; no manufacturer defaults
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Switch to manual dispatch without waiting for IT
Meet notification deadlines
Ransom decision rule with OFAC check
Annual incident response test and manual dispatch drill
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly
Retention: 6 years security; 5 years EMS records; 7 years PCS and claims
No criminal justice information without a CJIS program
Annual training; monthly reminders; phishing exercises
Quarterly manual dispatch drills
Approved generative AI tools only
